text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, to think that I could feel such<n>turbulence in my
heart...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heh... It was just a way to kill time at<n>first. But
then... I was so wrong...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Tragic fates, an inevitable clash<n>between two
visions of justice... I<n>was a fool to think it was only
for<n>children. I must thank Biko for<n>expanding my
world.
